tools.name: layout_book
tools.description: Lays out a story, memoir, letters or recipe collection from this conversation as a printed 8.5-inch square book and shows a page-by-page preview. tools.name: list_formats_and_prices
tools.description: Lists the printed book formats (hardcover, softcover), prices including shipping, and delivery times for a destination country. Use when the user asks what a printed book costs or how long delivery takes.

tools.name: create_print_order
tools.description: Creates a checkout link for a book laid out with layout_book. The user opens it, enters the shipping address and pays on inkbind.onmax.me; only then is the book printed. Nothing is charged by this call.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Returns the status and tracking link of a printed book order by its order code (looks like IB-XXXXXXX).
